description:
Quick Dutch train departures for your daily route
Tjoeke shows upcoming train departures for your regular route in the Netherlands. Pick two stations and see the next trains in both directions at a glance.

Features:
• Forward and backward departures on one screen
• Station search with autocomplete
• Intercity-only filter
• Off-peak (daluren) discount indicator
• Three themes: light, dark, and high-contrast (e-ink friendly)
• Auto-refresh every 2 minutes
• Tiny app, minimal permissions (internet only)

Tjoeke uses the NS (Dutch Railways) API via a lightweight proxy. No account needed, no tracking, no ads.
